description: Performance budgets (docs/13 §17, docs/15 §11.6). The web numbers are a regression guard set about 20% above the first measured build (dist-w1, 2026-11-18: JavaScript 6.63 MB, gzip 1.32 MB, first screen 5.29 MB, largest chunk 4.22 MB). They are not product targets. Product targets are in productTargets and are measured by the CI perf job and on devices.

productTargets.measuredBy: Lighthouse in the CI perf job (web). Android: not measured, needs a device or emulator.
